messages:
Priya Narang: FYI team  compressed QBR with AstraFleet next Thu, 15m with SVP Customer Ops. Need a concise executive "asks" slide, onboarding gate list (security + webhooks), renewal hangpoints, and clear owners. Drive: https://tiny.redwood/astrafleet-qbr

Kiran Desai: I'll pull 30/60 retention numbers and webhook failure rates. Will add to slide 3.

Naomi Park: Renewal signal = borderline. Key hangpoints: pending security audit, webhook error spikes, and schema mismatch for events export. Recommend exec ask: greenlight security window + temporary retry credits.

Omar Reyes: Security audit is blocking onboarding sign-off. Eng triage scheduled Wed 14:00. If audit passes, we can clear the primary gate. Also routing smoke tests pending.

Carmen Li: I can run a focused 4-day enablement to re-run walk-throughs and capture playbook gaps. Request 5 SE-hours. Will prepare a 1-pager.

Priya Narang: Please add a 1-line "ask for exec" into slide 1 by EOD today. Keep it action-oriented (approve security window / authorize retry credits / sign-off on routing plan).

Kiran Desai: Added retention table + webhook error heatmap. Note: retry middleware could reduce visible errors by ~35% in our sim.

Naomi Park: Security audit update: external vendor kickoff set for Tue. ETA for report: Fri EOD. We should condition the renewal ask on a pass or remediation plan.

ops-bot: Reminder set: final deck review on 2025-12-02 16:00 PST.

Priya Narang: Action items (posting here so thread is canonical):
```
- Carmen: enablement runbook + SE-hours request (due Tue EOD)
- Kiran: data slides (retention + webhook heatmap) (due Wed noon)
- Naomi: security audit status + remediation brief (due Thu 10:00)
- Omar: routing smoke test schedule + owner (due Thu 5pm)
- Priya: synthesize exec slide + one-line asks (due Thu EOD)
```

Kiran Desai: I'll add a short appendix showing retention delta under two scenarios: with retry credits and with schema fix.

Carmen Li: Will post runbook Tue and prep a short demo for the dry run.

Naomi Park: If the audit flags high-severity items, propose we ask execs for a 2-week remediation window and temporary SLA carve-out. Adding to doc.

Priya Narang: Dry run Fri 09:00 (12m). Ill send calendar invite and the runbook. Everyone keep remarks to 60-90s.

Omar Reyes: Acknowledged. I'll join and present routing results.

Kiran Desai: :thumbsup: will be on the run.

Carmen Li: On it.
